description: Defines a `TemplateRef` that is not rendered until a directive or outlet instantiates it.
Logical grouping element that renders no DOM node.
`#name` on an element, component or `<ng-template>`, usable elsewhere in the same template.
Renders a `TemplateRef` at a location with an optional context: `*ngTemplateOutlet="tpl; context: ctx"`.
Inputs of an `<ng-template>` read from the context: `let-item` reads `$implicit`, `let-i="index"` reads `index`.
Declares a read-only local variable inside a template.
